R1_glucosepane.summary: Review of the glucosepane chemistry, source mapping, protonation/charge state, and matched-control preparation confirms that the 56-atom split-residue topology (AGS: 38 atoms, LGX: 18 atoms; AGS:NZ-LGX:CE bond = 0.147 nm) and OpenMM force/energy equivalence against the GROMACS Amber99SB*-ILDNP parser are numerically verified. However, five concrete chemical and methodological issues must be resolved before longer production or mechanical MD: (1) replacing the neutral glucosepane crosslink with juxtaposed ARG(+1) and LYS(+1) side chains on two untethered 15-mer single strands introduces strong local +1/+1 Coulombic repulsion and free strand dissociation in GLU_CONTROL; (2) the source ColBuilder RTP models glucosepane as a deprotonated neutral ring (joint charge -1e-6 e) rather than the physiological protonated (+1 e) cyclic guanidinium state; (3) solute side chains are energy-minimized in vacuum (NoCutoff) prior to solvation; (4) the 80-atom motif mapping and runtime tetrahedral checks validate only 2D graph isomorphism and relative volume-sign retention, not absolute (R/S) stereochemistry at the three glucosepane ring stereocenters; and (5) GLU_CONTROL mixes one double-precision replica (10.211 A) with two mixed-precision replicas (12.525 A, 11.919 A).

findings.title: Unlinked control (GLU_CONTROL) introduces direct ARG(+1)/LYS(+1) interface repulsion between two untethered single strands
findings.evidence: GLU_LINKED connects two excised 15-residue single chains (chain 23 resid 101 and chain 19 resid 1046) via a neutral AGS-LGX bridge (solute charge -1 e), whereas GLU_CONTROL restores positively charged ARG(+1) and LYS(+1) side chains at the former 1.458 A crosslink site (solute charge +1 e, 471 vs 481 solute atoms) with all positional restraints set to k = 0 during the 30-ps production window.
findings.implication: Beyond the acknowledged global counterion swap (11 Na/12 Cl vs 12 Na/11 Cl), placing +1 ARG and +1 LYS face-to-face at a 1.46 A starting contact between two isolated single strands lacking triple-helical partner chains or terminal boundary restraints actively drives electrostatic strand separation, confounding covalent link removal with local Coulombic repulsion and free two-chain diffusion.
findings.recommended_check: Include a charge-matched unlinked control (neutral LYN and deprotonated ARG or capped neutral half-link residues) alongside a protonated (+1 e) glucosepane model, and apply weak terminal C-alpha positional restraints on the two excised 15-mer ends to represent the omitted triple-helical/fibril scaffold.

findings.title: Source neutral glucosepane parameterization omits the physiological protonated (+1 e) cyclic guanidinium state and leaves a -1e-6 e charge residual
findings.evidence: AGS (38 atoms, charge +0.065840 e, containing N*, N2, N3 atom types) and LGX (18 atoms, charge -0.065841 e) sum to a neutral joint_charge_e of -1.000000000139778e-06 e rather than +1.0 e.
findings.implication: Glucosepane contains a bicyclic 6-amino-7,8-dihydro-5H-imidazo[4,5-b]azepine (cyclic guanidinium) core that is protonated (+1 e) at physiological pH 7.4; modeling the deprotonated neutral free base alters local hydration, salt-bridge interactions, and ring torsional electrostatics, while the -1e-6 e partial-charge rounding mismatch leaves a tiny non-zero net system charge (-1e-6 e) under PME.
findings.recommended_check: Benchmark the neutral ColBuilder AGS/LGX charges against a protonated (+1 e) glucosepane RESP parameterization at pH 7.4, and adjust the AGS/LGX boundary charge by +1e-6 e so the joint residue charge is an exact integer.

findings.title: Vacuum (NoCutoff) side-chain minimization precedes solvation and box construction
findings.evidence: In prepare(), GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED construct a gas-phase NoCutoff System, restrain only backbone N, CA, C, O atoms (k = 1000 kJ/mol/nm^2), minimize all side chains for up to 2000 steps in vacuum, and pass the vacuum-relaxed coordinates directly to solvate().
findings.implication: Unrestrained side-chain minimization in vacuum (dielectric = 1) exposes the restored ARG(+1)/LYS(+1) side chains in GLU_CONTROL and the polar hydroxyl/ring nitrogens of AGS/LGX in GLU_LINKED to unscreened gas-phase Coulomb forces, promoting artificial intramolecular salt bridges or side-chain repulsion that alters principal-axis box sizing and initial solvation.
findings.recommended_check: Restrain all heavy solute atoms during dry clash relief (relaxing only added hydrogens) or perform side-chain minimization exclusively after explicit TIP3P water and NaCl ions are added.

findings.title: 2D graph-isomorphism mapping and relative determinant signs do not verify absolute (R/S) stereochemistry of the three glucosepane ring stereocenters
findings.evidence: The 80-atom reference motif mapping is verified solely by 2D graph invariants (element, degree, charge, all edges and nonedges), and runtime stereocenter monitoring (28 centers in GLU_CONTROL vs 31 in GLU_LINKED) tests only whether determinant signs invert relative to the initial coordinate array.
findings.implication: Graph isomorphism is invariant to 3D tetrahedral inversion and prochiral CH2 hydrogen swaps. If the upstream ColBuilder fibril coordinates for resid 101/1046 started with a diastereomeric flip at any of the three extra glucosepane ring chiral centers (C6, C7, C8) or swapped geminal atoms in an improper torsion, the relative sign check (inversions == 0) will pass while simulating the wrong diastereomer.
findings.recommended_check: Compute explicit Cahn-Ingold-Prelog (R/S) configurations for the three AGS ring stereocenters in the starting coordinates and verify against canonical D-glucose-derived glucosepane stereochemistry.

findings.title: Integration precision asymmetry in GLU_CONTROL and duplicate harmonic X-H bonds on constrained solute pairs
findings.evidence: GLU_CONTROL combines one double-precision replica (mean C-alpha distance 10.2110 A) with two mixed-precision replicas (12.5252 A and 11.9192 A), whereas GLU_LINKED uses three mixed-precision replicas; additionally, candidate_pilot.py line 124 adds HBonds constraints to GLU solute X-H pairs without removing their HarmonicBondForce entries from line 26.
findings.implication: The single double-precision trajectory in GLU_CONTROL is a low-distance outlier (10.211 A vs 12.525 A and 11.919 A), inflating the reported GLU_CONTROL replica SD (1.2000 A) and shifting the group mean in the small n = 3 sample.
findings.recommended_check: Re-run GLU_CONTROL replica 0 in mixed precision (or run all replicas in uniform double precision) and omit constrained X-H pairs from HarmonicBondForce when constructing the wet Amber System.

R1_glucosepane.strongest_surviving_claim: The split-residue glucosepane topology (AGS:NZ-LGX:CE) and its unlinked Arg/Lys control are numerically self-consistent in OpenMM, reproducing the GROMACS Amber99SB*-ILDNP topology parser to ~10^-14 kJ/mol/atom in dry energy and ~10^-13 kJ/mol/nm in forces, and completing twelve 50-ps explicit-solvent trajectories without constraint violations or relative tetrahedral sign inversions.
R1_glucosepane.decisive_next_experiment: Before longer MD, run a 4-arm controlled glucosepane validation in a triple-helical collagen model peptide (or end-tethered two-chain excerpt) under uniform integration precision with explicit-solvent-first side-chain equilibration: (1) Priority 1 — verify absolute CIP (R/S) stereochemistry of the 3 AGS ring chiral centers against canonical D-glucose-derived glucosepane; (2) Priority 2 — compare four chemical states: (a) neutral glucosepane (AGS+LGX = 0 e), (b) physiological protonated glucosepane (AGS+LGX = +1 e), (c) canonical charged unlinked control (ARG+1 / LYS+1), and (d) charge-matched neutral unlinked control (deprotonated ARG0 / LYN0) with weak terminal C-alpha positional restraints (k = 10 kJ/mol/nm^2 on terminal residues only) across n >= 5 independent solvent/velocity seeds ( >= 5 ns per replica); (3) Recorded observables — inter-chain modified C-alpha distance distribution, AGS/LGX ring puckering and torsion distributions, radial distribution of Na+/Cl- and water around the imidazoazepine ring, and block-averaged standard errors; (4) Convergence/stop criteria — block-averaged C-alpha distance SEM < 0.15 A and split-half ring torsion JSD < 0.05; (5) Falsifier — if the C-alpha distance shift between canonical unlinked (ARG+1/LYS+1) and charge-matched neutral unlinked (ARG0/LYN0) exceeds 50% of the difference between GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED, the pilot C-alpha difference is dominated by local electrostatic repulsion and strand untethering rather than covalent crosslink mechanics.

literature_to_verify.query: Giannetti et al. PMC13348703 AGEs-ColBuilder glucosepane AGS LGX protonation state RESP charge derivation and ring stereochemistry
literature_to_verify.reason: Verify why the published ColBuilder AGS and LGX RTP entries sum to neutral charge (-1e-6 e) instead of +1 e and confirm which diastereomer of glucosepane was parameterized.

literature_to_verify.query: Glucosepane 6-amino-7,8-dihydro-5H-imidazo[4,5-b]azepine experimental pKa NMR stereochemistry and physiological protonation state at pH 7.4
literature_to_verify.reason: Confirm the experimental pKa of the bicyclic guanidinium core of glucosepane and the canonical configurations of its three ring stereocenters derived from D-glucose.

R2_dityrosine.summary: Audit of the dityrosine (DITY) parameter translation, local 40-atom patch graph, and 21-residue N-telopeptide context confirms that the local topological counts (40 atoms, 41 bonds, 66 angles, 98 proper torsions), zero net side-chain charge (0.0 e per patched pair; -1.0 e full peptide), and CHARMM-to-OpenMM unit conversions in DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json are arithmetically exact. Separating CGenFF penalty annotations from actual implementation errors reveals that the 51.1 penalty and other OG312 entries in PARAMETER_AUDIT.json belong to uninstantiated DOPA-dianion parameters from the source file, whereas the active 41.1 and 30.0 penalties apply to intra-ring 2-fold planarity terms around 1CZ-1CE2 (CA-CG2R67) rather than the central inter-ring 1CE2-2CE2 (CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA) rotor, which inherited an unpenalized generic biphenyl 2-fold cosine without ortho-hydroxyl n=1/n=3 terms. However, three concrete validity threats affect the dityrosine model: (1) DITY_LINKED.json starts from unlinked DITY_CONTROL coordinates where 1CE2 and 2CE2 are 8.630 A apart and closes the bond via backbone-restrained Cartesian minimization, trapping strain in the formed link; (2) the custom charmm36_dity.xml setup lacked a two-parser energy/force cross-check analogous to the GromacsTopFile check run for glucosepane; and (3) the intramolecular i, i+2 (Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6) single-chain context fixes the C-alpha marker near 7.1 A by backbone covalent geometry while using an anisotropic ~9.5 x 3.8 x 3.3 nm box that cannot support longer unrestrained rotational tumbling.

findings.title: DITY_LINKED starts with an 8.630 A crosslink bond closed by backbone-restrained Cartesian minimization
findings.evidence: DITY_LINKED.json uses the exact initial atomic coordinates of DITY_CONTROL.json (with 1HE2 and 2HE2 deleted) while adding bond [51, 78] between Tyr4:CE2 ([1.510, -13.336, -25.377] A) and Tyr6:CE2 ([-1.705, -12.204, -17.448] A), producing an initial 1CE2-2CE2 distance of 8.630 A (5.79x the 1.490 A equilibrium length). In candidate/candidate_pilot.py (lines 68-74), LocalEnergyMinimizer pulls this 8.630 A bond closed while harmonic restraints (k = 1000 kJ/mol/nm^2) pin all backbone N, CA, C, O atoms to the unlinked pose.
findings.implication: Pulling two phenol rings across an 8.630 A gap without prior rotamer/backbone conformational search traps the Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 macrocycle in a strained local minimum, consistent with the persistently stretched mean 1CE2-2CE2 bond length of 1.5090 A vs r0 = 1.490 A (candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md, line 41) and 0.128437 A peak bond deviation (line 45).
findings.recommended_check: Generate initial DITY_LINKED coordinates via unrestrained side-chain/loop conformational sampling (scanning Tyr4/Tyr6 chi1, chi2 and Gly5 phi, psi) until the pre-minimization 1CE2-2CE2 distance is <= 1.65 A and ring out-of-plane distortion is < 5 deg before applying backbone restraints or solvating.

findings.title: CGenFF penalties 41.1 and 30.0 govern intra-ring planarity, while the central inter-ring rotor uses generic biphenyl terms
findings.evidence: Of the 10 CGenFF penalty annotations in PARAMETER_AUDIT.json (lines 72-113), four OG312 rules (including penalty 51.1 at line 98) come from deprotonated G_dopxdianion_G.str and are absent from neutral DITY, and CG2R67-CA-CA-OH1 (line 110; DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json, line 426) is a DOPA rule with no matching 4-atom path in DITY. The two active elevated penalties—41.1 for OH1-CA-CG2R67-CG2R67 (line 90, 1OH-1CZ-1CE2-2CE2) and 30.0 for OH1-CA-CG2R67-CA (line 94, 1OH-1CZ-1CE2-1CD2)—rotate around the intra-ring 1CZ-1CE2 (CA-CG2R67) bond (n = 2, phase = 180 deg). Meanwhile, the actual inter-ring crosslink torsion CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA (DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json, line 325, k = 3.72376 kJ/mol, n = 2, phase = 180 deg) carries zero CGenFF penalty only because it copies unsubstituted biphenyl.
findings.implication: The CGenFF penalty annotations are uncertainty flags rather than translation bugs, but focusing only on penalties 30 and 41.1 misses the physical parameterization issue: the central 1CE2-2CE2 rotor (CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA) lacks n = 1 and n = 3 Fourier terms needed to represent 2,2'-biphenol ortho-OH steric clash and intramolecular OH...OH hydrogen-bonding asymmetry.
findings.recommended_check: Perform a 1D/2D QM torsion benchmark on a 2,2'-biphenol / capped-dityrosine model scanning the central C_zeta1-C_epsilon2,1-C_epsilon2,2-C_zeta2 dihedral (0 to 360 deg in 15 deg steps) and coupled C_epsilon2-C_zeta-O_eta-H_eta rotamers, fitting n = 1, 2, 3, 4 cosine terms for CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA while checking that the penalty-41.1/30.0 terms keep bridgehead out-of-plane wagging within <= 3 deg of QM geometries.

findings.title: No independent CHARMM parser cross-check was executed for the patched charmm36_dity.xml topology
findings.evidence: Whereas GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED are cross-checked against openmm.app.GromacsTopFile (lines 81-85), DITY_CONTROL and DITY_LINKED set cross=None (line 80) and only compare OpenMM Reference vs CUDA on the identical serialized XML System (line 75). Although the 19 bonded conversions and CG2R67 LJ parameters in DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json (lines 5-454) are arithmetically exact, full-context patch application (1-4 nonbonded exclusions/scalings across 1CE2-2CE2, 22 CMAP terms, and backbone impropers) relies on a single XML code path.
findings.implication: Any discrepancy in how OpenMM's XML residue template/patch matcher generates 1-4 exceptions or improper ordering across the inter-residue 1CE2-2CE2 bond would pass the Reference/CUDA check undetected.
findings.recommended_check: Using openmm.app.CharmmPsfFile and CharmmParameterSet (already present in the locked OpenMM wheel), load the native CHARMM .psf/.prm/.str build of the 21-residue DITY_LINKED peptide and require single-point Reference energy agreement < 1e-5 kJ/mol/atom and force RMS < 1e-2 kJ/mol/nm against charmm36_dity.xml.

findings.title: Intramolecular i, i+2 (Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6) link and anisotropic box geometry confound the C-alpha marker and longer unrestrained runs
findings.evidence: DITY_LINKED links Tyr4 and Tyr6 separated by a single residue (Gly5) on one chain, where the covalent backbone already holds C-alpha(Tyr4)-C-alpha(Tyr6) at 7.291 A initially and 7.1590 +/- 0.0616 A in DITY_CONTROL vs 7.0470 +/- 0.0733 A in DITY_LINKED (lines 40-41). In addition, candidate/candidate_pilot.py (lines 110-116) aligns the 7.10 nm extended peptide along principal axes with a +2.4 nm buffer per axis, yielding an anisotropic ~9.5 x 3.8 x 3.3 nm^3 box (~118 nm^3 from the 0.140929 M salt concentration at line 18).
findings.implication: The C-alpha(Tyr4)-C-alpha(Tyr6) distance is structurally clamped by the intervening Gly5 backbone and cannot resolve crosslink mechanical stiffening; moreover, extending unrestrained MD beyond 30 ps in the ~3.3-3.8 nm transverse box will allow rotational tumbling of the 7.10 nm peptide into its periodic image.
findings.recommended_check: Compare an intermolecular two-chain dityrosine model (or track end-to-end telopeptide extension and ring-ring distances rather than i, i+2 C-alpha distance) and solvate in a padded cubic/dodecahedral box (>= 9.5 nm on all axes) or apply weak terminal C-alpha orientational anchors when running longer unrestrained trajectories.

findings.title: Runtime geometry checks omit sp2 bridgehead planarity, inter-ring torsion distributions, and heavy-atom bond strain
findings.evidence: The stereocenter tracker centers(d) (line 47) filters strictly for 4-coordinate sp3 carbons (len(ns)==4), monitoring 20 tetrahedral centers in DITY while ignoring sp2 planarity at 1CE2, 2CE2 (CG2R67) and 1CZ, 2CZ (CA). During MD (lines 155-157), only X-H constraint errors are checked per chunk; neither the inter-ring dihedral (1CZ-1CE2-2CE2-2CZ), bridgehead out-of-plane angles, nor the 1CE2-2CE2 bond length time series are output to NUMERIC_READBACK.json.
findings.implication: Because DITY_LINKED was minimized from an 8.630 A initial bond, unmonitored sp2 out-of-plane pyramidalization at 1CE2/2CE2 or trapped high-energy biphenyl torsion states could persist throughout the 30-ps unrestrained window without triggering any runtime gate.
findings.recommended_check: Add deterministic trajectory readbacks for (1) the central inter-ring torsion psi_link (1CZ-1CE2-2CE2-2CZ), (2) out-of-plane improper angles at 1CE2, 2CE2, 1CZ, and 2CZ, (3) Tyr4/Tyr6 (chi1, chi2) and Gly5 (phi, psi) dihedrals, and (4) the 1CE2-2CE2 bond length distribution across all saved frames in solute_frames_nm.npy.

R2_dityrosine.strongest_surviving_claim: The local 40-atom DITY patch graph (41 bonds, 66 angles, 98 proper torsions, 0.0 e net side-chain charge, and -1.0 e full-peptide charge) and all 19 bonded and Lennard-Jones unit translations from the source CHARMM/CGenFF stream/parameter archive into OpenMM XML are arithmetically exact, and all six DITY_CONTROL and DITY_LINKED 50-ps trajectories completed in mixed precision with verified Reference/CUDA agreement and stable constraints.
R2_dityrosine.decisive_next_experiment: Priority 1 (Offline trajectory readback on existing solute_frames_nm.npy): Compute the time series and distributions of the central crosslink bond length r(1CE2-2CE2), inter-ring dihedral psi_link (1CZ-1CE2-2CE2-2CZ), bridgehead sp2 out-of-plane improper angles at 1CE2/2CE2/1CZ/2CZ, and Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 (chi1, chi2, phi, psi) angles across the existing 3 x 50 ps DITY_LINKED and DITY_CONTROL runs. Priority 2 (Parser cross-check): Verify charmm36_dity.xml single-point energy and forces on DITY_LINKED against openmm.app.CharmmPsfFile/CharmmParameterSet loaded directly from the source CHARMM .psf/.prm/.str files (stop criterion: energy difference < 1e-5 kJ/mol/atom and force RMS < 1e-2 kJ/mol/nm). Priority 3 (QM torsion/geometry validation and rotamer-relaxed rebuild): Run a constrained QM torsion scan (e.g., revDSD-PBEP86-D3BJ or MP2/def2-TZVP // B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP in implicit water) on a 2,2'-biphenol / capped-dityrosine dimer over psi_link in 15 deg increments for cis/trans OH rotamers; refit CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA (n = 1..4) and check penalty-41.1/30.0 out-of-plane terms. Rebuild DITY_LINKED by pre-relaxing Tyr4/Tyr6 rotamers so initial r(1CE2-2CE2) <= 1.65 A before backbone-restrained minimization. Convergence/stop criteria: QM vs MM torsion profile RMSE <= 2.0 kJ/mol across all minima/barriers within 25 kJ/mol of the global minimum, equilibrium MM mean bond length |<r(1CE2-2CE2)> - 1.490 A| <= 0.008 A, and sp2 out-of-plane angle RMS < 4 deg. Falsifier: If pre-relaxed rotamer initialization plus QM-refitted inter-ring torsions still yield a strained 1CE2-2CE2 bond (> 1.505 A) or > 10 deg sp2 ring distortion in the Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 N-telopeptide, reject the intramolecular i, i+2 Tyr4-Tyr6 crosslink hypothesis in favor of an intermolecular dityrosine model.

literature_to_verify.query: Graham et al. 2026 xcrp 103319 Zenodo 16865891 G_dity_G.str DITY patch CGenFF validation
literature_to_verify.reason: Verify whether the source authors performed any QM torsion scan or geometry benchmark for the DITY patch (specifically CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA and the penalty 41.1/30.0 OH1-CA-CG2R67 terms) or generated it solely via automated CGenFF analogy.

literature_to_verify.query: 2,2'-biphenol quantum mechanical torsion potential barrier ortho hydroxyl hydrogen bonding biphenyl CGenFF
literature_to_verify.reason: Establish an independent experimental and ab initio reference for the equilibrium inter-ring dihedral angle, cis/trans OH rotamer preference, and rotational barriers of the ortho,ortho'-biphenol core in dityrosine.

literature_to_verify.query: collagen type I N-telopeptide dityrosine crosslink intramolecular Tyr4 Tyr6 versus intermolecular
literature_to_verify.reason: Verify whether dityrosine crosslinks in human type I collagen N-telopeptide occur intermolecularly between adjacent telopeptides/helices or intramolecularly across the i, i+2 Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 motif.

R3_sampling.summary: The glucosepane/dityrosine MD pilot successfully establishes numerically stable, reproducible OpenMM model builds and platform-consistent force evaluations across 12 short trajectories (600 ps total), while appropriately disclaiming equilibrium and cross-chemistry mechanical rankings. However, an audit of the sampling design, precision interruption handling, and local readback code (`candidate/local_analysis.py`) identifies five concrete threats to statistical and numerical inference: (1) an unbalanced integration-precision and driver-version switch (`double` in `attempt-001` vs `mixed` in `attempt-002`) occurs solely in `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0, confounding the reported inter-seed variance; (2) the 30-ps `NPT_free` marker analysis applies zero burn-in after releasing a 100 kJ/mol/nm² heavy-solute restraint and reports no autocorrelation or effective sample size diagnostics; (3) the three replicas per model share a single solvent/ion build and minimized starting structure, providing velocity-seed realizations (`df = 0` for solvent/conformational variance) while `GLU_CONTROL` relaxes from a non-equilibrium crosslinked pose; (4) `local_analysis.py` omits periodic minimum-image wrapping on `linkdist` and `maxdev`, computes `final_heavy_solute_displacement_A` without periodic wrapping or rotational/translational alignment, and reconstructs per-frame box dimensions indirectly from density ratios; and (5) `PARAMETER_AUDIT.json` contains four elevated CGenFF dihedral penalties (up to 51.1, vs 30 and 41.1 noted in the text), while the small `DITY` marker SD reflects kinetic trapping within a single rotamer basin over 30 ps rather than statistical convergence.

findings.title: Unbalanced double-vs-mixed precision and driver switch confounds GLU_CONTROL inter-seed variance
findings.evidence: In `evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json` (lines 9-20) and `candidate/replica_summary.csv` (lines 2-4), `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 (`attempt-001`, `double` precision, driver `9656f6...` in `candidate/retrieved/resume-metadata.json` line 3) has a Cα marker mean of 10.2110 Å and final temperature 303.85 K, whereas Replicas 1 and 2 (`attempt-002`, `mixed` precision, driver `0dc5f6...`) have means of 12.5252 Å and 11.9192 Å. Meanwhile, `candidate/retrieved/performance-interruption.json` (lines 49-63) shows an unanalyzed 21-ps `double`-precision run of `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 1 already exists in `attempt-001`.
findings.implication: Pooling one `double`-precision trajectory with two `mixed`-precision trajectories inflates the reported `GLU_CONTROL` sample SD of replica means to 1.2000 Å (versus 0.4285 Å across the two `mixed` replicas alone) and shifts the group mean by -0.6704 Å. The interpretation in `candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` (line 43) that 'glucosepane controls vary substantially between seeds' cannot separate velocity-seed divergence from the precision and driver change.
findings.recommended_check: Compare the preserved 21-ps `double`-precision trajectory in `attempt-001/run/GLU_CONTROL/replica_1/progress.json` directly against the first 21 ps of `attempt-002/run/GLU_CONTROL/replica_1`, and re-run `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 (`seed 20261101`) in `mixed` precision under `attempt-002` (~2 min wall time) to establish a balanced 12-replica design.

findings.title: Zero post-restraint burn-in and unquantified autocorrelation in the 30-ps NPT_free window
findings.evidence: `candidate/local_analysis.py` (lines 25, 54-62) averages all 30 frames saved during `NPT_free` (`assert len(tail)==30`, 1 frame/ps from 21 to 50 ps) immediately after the 100 kJ/mol/nm² heavy-solute restraint is stepped to zero at 20 ps (`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` line 32), with no equilibration discard and no autocorrelation check.
findings.implication: Stepping the heavy-atom restraint from 100 kJ/mol/nm² to 0 induces a deterministic relaxation transient—especially in `GLU_CONTROL`, where two unlinked 15-residue chains start from a crosslinked fibril pose (`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` line 43). Averaging from t = 21 ps mixes transient drift into `free_tail_CA_marker_mean_A` and conflates non-stationary drift with thermal fluctuation in `free_tail_CA_marker_SD_A`.
findings.recommended_check: Using the existing 30-frame `solute_frames_nm.npy` arrays, compute linear drift slopes, first-half (21-35 ps) versus second-half (36-50 ps) block means, and integrated autocorrelation times (tau_int) to determine the post-release burn-in time and effective sample size (N_eff).

findings.title: Shared solvent/minimized build and unrelaxed control pose create pseudo-replication across seeds
findings.evidence: Each model uses a single solvent build and minimized starting structure across all three velocity seeds (`candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` line 32), keeps heavy solute atoms restrained for the first 20 ps, and compares `GLU_CONTROL` (+1 e solute charge, 11 Na / 12 Cl, unlinked chains starting in a crosslinked reference pose, lines 15-20, 43) against `GLU_LINKED` (-1 e solute charge, 12 Na / 11 Cl).
findings.implication: Because heavy solute atoms are restrained during the 20-ps pre-production stages, the three velocity seeds per model cannot randomize backbone conformations or counterion atmospheres prior to the 30-ps readback window (`df = 0` for starting conformer and solvent/ion placement). Paired `LINKED` versus `CONTROL` marker differences additionally confound covalent linkage with a 2 e net charge shift, ion count differences, and asymmetric starting-pose disequilibrium.
findings.recommended_check: Compute pairwise heavy-atom RMSDs among the three replicas at t = 20 ps (restraint release) to quantify pre-release conformational collapse onto the single minimized pose, and generate independent solvent/ion builds and independently equilibrated unlinked control conformations for future comparisons.

findings.title: Inconsistent PBC wrapping, unaligned displacement metric, and density-scaled box reconstruction in local_analysis.py
findings.evidence: In `candidate/local_analysis.py`, line 28 reads only diagonal box lengths from `final_state.xml` and line 55 reconstructs per-frame boxes via `(progress[-1]['density_g_ml']/rec['density_g_ml'])**(1/3)`. Line 56 passes `current_box` to `dist()` for the Cα marker, but lines 42 (`maxdev`), 43 (`final_heavy_solute_displacement_A`), and 57 (`linkdist`) call `dist()` without periodic box wrapping, and line 43 omits rotational/translational alignment.
findings.implication: `final_heavy_solute_displacement_A` (2.47-3.85 Å in `candidate/replica_summary.csv`) mixes rigid-body center-of-mass translation and rotation during the 30-ps unrestrained NPT stage with internal solute deformation. Furthermore, omitting `current_box` in `linkdist` (line 57) and `maxdev` (line 42) risks periodic-boundary jumps whenever bonded atoms or linked chains wrap across box edges.
findings.recommended_check: Record exact per-frame `PeriodicBoxVectors` in `progress.json`, pass `current_box` to all `dist()` evaluations in `local_analysis.py` (lines 42, 43, 57), and separate Kabsch-aligned internal heavy-atom RMSD from center-of-mass displacement.

findings.title: Unreported 51.1 CGenFF dihedral penalty in audit JSON and kinetic trapping of DITY biaryl torsions
findings.evidence: `candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md` (line 26) cites two elevated DITY torsion penalty annotations (30 and 41.1), whereas `candidate/PARAMETER_AUDIT.json` (lines 89-104) records four elevated dihedral penalties: 41.1 (line 90), 30.0 (line 94), 51.1 (line 98, `OG312-CA-CG2R67-CG2R67`), and 30.0 (line 102). Meanwhile, `DITY_CONTROL` and `DITY_LINKED` exhibit Cα marker replica SDs of only 0.0616 Å and 0.0733 Å (`evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json` lines 40, 55).
findings.implication: Hindered biaryl (`CG2R67-CG2R67`) torsions in the intramolecular Tyr4-Tyr6 crosslink cannot equilibrate across rotational barriers within 30 ps at 310 K. The ~0.06-0.07 Å inter-replica SD in `DITY` reflects kinetic trapping inside a single initial rotamer basin rather than converged sampling, while the active dihedral parameterization carries high CGenFF analogy penalties.
findings.recommended_check: Inspect `DITY_LINKED/dry_system.xml` to verify which high-penalty dihedral terms (41.1 vs 51.1) are active on the neutral DITY residue, and compute the time series and range of the `CD2-CE2-CE2-CD2` biaryl dihedral angle across all 30-ps `DITY_LINKED` trajectories to test for single-basin trapping.

R3_sampling.strongest_surviving_claim: All four solvated collagen-fragment models (`GLU_CONTROL`, `GLU_LINKED`, `DITY_CONTROL`, `DITY_LINKED`) are topologically complete, free of unresolved force-field parameters, consistent between OpenMM Reference (double) and CUDA platforms to ~10^-6 kJ/mol/atom in wet checks, and numerically stable across twelve 50-ps trajectories with zero tracked tetrahedral stereocenter inversions and constraint errors below 10^-6 nm.
R3_sampling.decisive_next_experiment: Priority 1 (Zero-compute diagnostics on existing data): In `candidate/local_analysis.py`, (a) compare the preserved `attempt-001` (`double` precision, 0-21 ps) and `attempt-002` (`mixed` precision, 0-21 ps) trajectories of `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 1; (b) compute linear drift slopes, first-half (21-35 ps) vs second-half (36-50 ps) block means, lag-1 autocorrelation, and integrated autocorrelation times (tau_int) for the Cα-Cα marker and `CD2-CE2-CE2-CD2` biaryl torsion; and (c) fix `local_analysis.py` to apply PBC wrapping to all distances and Kabsch alignment to heavy-atom RMSD. Priority 2 (Minimal balancing simulation, ~2 min wall time): Re-run `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 (`seed 20261101`) in `mixed` precision under the `attempt-002` driver so all 12 replicas share identical numerical precision and driver code. Priority 3 (Convergence and ensemble extension): Run 3 independent solvent/ion-placement builds per model with independent unlinked native equilibration (at least 10-50 ns unrestrained NPT per replica, or 1D umbrella sampling along the Cα-Cα distance). Controls: Matched `mixed` integration precision and driver hash across all replicas; independent solvent/ion coordinates per replica; explicit recording of exact per-frame periodic box vectors; separation of electrostatic (+1 e vs -1 e) and covalent effects. Recorded observables: True per-frame box vectors, PBC-wrapped Cα-Cα distance, PBC-wrapped crosslink bond length, Kabsch-aligned backbone and heavy-atom RMSDs, and crosslink dihedral angles. Convergence/stop criteria: Discard post-restraint burn-in until reverse-cumulative mean stabilizes within 1 SEM; require effective sample size N_eff = T_prod / (2 * tau_int) >= 20 per replica and agreement between first-half and second-half production block means within 1 SEM. Falsifier: If re-running `GLU_CONTROL` Replica 0 in `mixed` precision shifts its Cα marker mean from 10.21 Å into the 11.9-12.5 Å range of Replicas 1-2, the reported 1.20 Å inter-seed SD is falsified as a precision/attempt artifact; if 21-35 ps vs 36-50 ps block means differ significantly or N_eff < 2, stationary sampling within the 30-ps window is falsified.

R4_numerics.summary: Audit of the dynamics protocol and numerical validation scripts (candidate/candidate_pilot.py and candidate/local_analysis.py) confirms that the 12x50-ps trajectories executed inside an isolated, hash-verified environment and passed basic numerical stability checks (finite coordinates/forces/energies, constraint errors < 7.9e-7 nm, and stable bath temperatures/densities). However, five concrete implementation and validation issues were identified: (1) local_analysis.py reads dry_system.xml instead of final_system.xml (or wet_system.xml) when building RESULT_SUMMARY.json, misreporting dry solute force inventories as wet trajectory inventories, and omits minimum-image periodic wrapping for link-bond and RMSD calculations while reconstructing box lengths from rounded density; (2) stereocenter inversion checks ignore the solvation and wet-minimization step (m['signs'] is computed but never checked against wet-minimized coordinates xm) and evaluate only the determinant of three heavy neighbors without the fourth (hydrogen) substituent or periodic wrapping; (3) enabling the barostat at 10 ps calls Context.reinitialize(preserveState=True), which resets the LangevinMiddleIntegrator random number generator to its initial seed mid-trajectory; (4) CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md mischaracterizes the wet CPU/CUDA platform check as a double-precision comparison, whereas OpenMM's CPU platform executes in single/mixed precision; and (5) GLU_CONTROL pools one double-precision replica from attempt-001 with two mixed-precision replicas from attempt-002 across an unlinked two-chain excerpt whose net charge shifts by +2 e relative to GLU_LINKED. Consequently, the numerical checks establish only short-timescale integration stability and parser self-consistency within OpenMM; they do not establish parameter accuracy, thermodynamic equilibrium, or any mechanical effect of crosslinking.

findings.title: Post-hoc audit parses dry_system.xml instead of wet final_system.xml and omits periodic wrapping on link-bond and displacement metrics
findings.evidence: Line 33 of candidate/local_analysis.py parses RAW/case/'dry_system.xml' instead of p/'final_system.xml', causing every solvated trajectory row in candidate/RESULT_SUMMARY.json (e.g., lines 56 and 456) to report only vacuum solute particles (471, 481, 298, 296) in force_inventory with no solvent, barostat, or restraints. In addition, lines 42, 43, and 57 call dist() with box=None for bond deviations, heavy-atom RMSD, and link-bond lengths, while line 55 reconstructs current_box indirectly from density_g_ml ratios because candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 156 did not save per-frame box vectors bv.
findings.implication: The force_inventory in RESULT_SUMMARY.json does not audit the actual solvated System that was simulated, and the post-hoc distance checks (except the C-alpha marker on line 56) rely on OpenMM keeping solute chains in the same periodic image rather than enforcing minimum-image periodic boundaries with exact per-frame box vectors.
findings.recommended_check: Change candidate/local_analysis.py line 33 to parse p/'final_system.xml' (and verify particle/constraint counts against n_atoms), save periodic box vectors bv per frame in candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 156, and pass current_box to dist() on lines 42 and 57 of candidate/local_analysis.py.

findings.title: Stereocenter inversion gate skips the wet-minimization transition (m['signs'] is unused) and omits hydrogen coordinates
findings.evidence: Although prepare() (line 91) and resume (line 170) store dry-minimized determinant signs in m['signs'], run() never reads m['signs']; instead, line 149 defines initial_signs = signs(xm, cs) after wet LocalEnergyMinimizer.minimize (line 146), and candidate/local_analysis.py line 32 also compares final positions x against xm. Furthermore, centers(d) and signs(x, cs) (lines 47-48) compute det(x[js] - x[i]) using only three heavy-atom neighbors (js), excluding the attached hydrogen atom and omitting minimum-image wrapping.
findings.implication: If a stereocenter inverts during solvation or wet energy minimization (line 146), initial_signs adopts the inverted configuration as the reference and both runtime and post-hoc checks report zero inversions. Additionally, a local hydrogen-atom inversion across the heavy-atom pyramid without the central carbon crossing the heavy-neighbor plane cannot be detected.
findings.recommended_check: Compare wet-minimized signs(xm, cs) directly against the dry reference m['signs'] immediately after line 146 of candidate/candidate_pilot.py, and compute signed tetrahedral volumes using all four bonded substituents (including the hydrogen atom) with minimum-image displacement vectors.

findings.title: Barostat activation at 10 ps calls c.reinitialize(preserveState=True), resetting the Langevin PRNG sequence mid-trajectory
findings.evidence: At the transition from NVT to NPT (10 ps, step 10,000), line 152 calls baro.setFrequency(25); c.reinitialize(preserveState=True) without updating the integrator seed set at line 37 (it.setRandomNumberSeed(seed)). In OpenMM, reinitialize(preserveState=True) preserves positions, velocities, box vectors, and parameters, but rebuilds the platform Context and re-seeds the LangevinMiddleIntegrator random number generator from its static seed property.
findings.implication: The random thermal noise sequence applied during the first 10,000 steps (heat + NVT) is replayed identically starting at step 10,001 (NPT), introducing an artificial correlation between the equilibration and production stochastic bath sequences. Similarly, final_state.xml (line 159) does not preserve internal PRNG states for exact continuation.
findings.recommended_check: Assign a stage-specific deterministic seed (e.g., it.setRandomNumberSeed(seed + 1000)) immediately before calling c.reinitialize(preserveState=True) on line 152 of candidate/candidate_pilot.py.

findings.title: Wet CPU/CUDA platform check is mischaracterized as a double-precision comparison and evaluates an unrestrained system on GPU-minimized coordinates
findings.evidence: Line 50 of candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md states that 'Energy/force comparisons remained in double precision.' However, in candidate/candidate_pilot.py lines 38-41 and 147, energy_forces(m['wet'], xm, 'CPU') passes {'Threads': '2'} to OpenMM's CPU platform, which executes PME and nonbonded forces in single/mixed precision (32-bit float SIMD), unlike the double-precision Reference platform used in the dry check (line 75). Moreover, xm is produced by CUDA minimization on the restrained system s (which ran in double precision in attempt-001 and mixed precision in attempt-002), while energy_forces evaluates the unrestrained system m['wet'].
findings.implication: The wet platform check (~6e-6 kJ/mol/atom and ~0.0025 kJ/mol/nm force RMS in RESULT_SUMMARY.json) measures single/mixed-precision CPU agreement against double-precision CUDA rather than double-precision agreement across platforms, and varies across replicas because xm depends on the prior CUDA minimization precision and seed.
findings.recommended_check: Correct the text in candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md line 50 to specify that only the dry Reference/CUDA check is double-precision on both platforms while the wet check compares CPU (single/mixed precision) against CUDA (double precision), and evaluate wet platform agreement on the identical system s prior to GPU minimization.

findings.title: Precision heterogeneity in GLU_CONTROL, unisolated +2e charge shift, two-chain drift, and wide runtime gates restrict physical inference
findings.evidence: In evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json lines 7-20, GLU_CONTROL pools one double-precision replica from attempt-001 (mean C-alpha distance 10.2110 A) with two mixed-precision replicas from attempt-002 (12.5252 A and 11.9192 A), yielding a sample SD of 1.2000 A across replica means. Simultaneously, restoring Arg/Lys in GLU_CONTROL removes the inter-chain covalent link between the two 15-residue peptides while shifting net solute charge from -1 e to +1 e (candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md line 20), and runtime gates in candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 157 only reject gross blow-ups (20 < T < 650 K, 0.5 < density < 1.5 g/mL).
findings.implication: The C-alpha distance difference and variance between GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED confound precision mode, unrestrained two-chain translational/rotational drift from a crosslinked starting pose, and a 2-unit electrostatic/counterion change. Passing the loose runtime gates confirms only absence of numerical explosion, not conformational convergence or mechanical stiffness.
findings.recommended_check: Re-run GLU_CONTROL replica 0 in mixed precision for uniform precision across all 12 trajectories, apply terminal C-alpha positional/distance restraints to mimic fibril embedding in both linked and unlinked two-chain controls, and tighten NPT_free acceptance bounds around target equilibrium (e.g., 290 < T < 330 K and 0.96 < density < 1.04 g/mL).

R4_numerics.strongest_surviving_claim: All four solvated atomistic setups (GLU_CONTROL, GLU_LINKED, DITY_CONTROL, DITY_LINKED) have complete force-field parameter assignments within their respective OpenMM Amber99-compatible and CHARMM36/CGenFF representations, agree between OpenMM parsers/platforms within single/mixed-precision tolerances, and integrate stably for 3 x 50 ps per model at 310 K and 1 bar without NaNs, constraint violations above 7.9e-7 nm, or heavy-atom pyramid inversions during the post-minimization trajectory.
R4_numerics.decisive_next_experiment: Priority 1 (Validation & Protocol Fix): Patch candidate/local_analysis.py (line 33 to parse final_system.xml; lines 42 and 57 to pass per-frame box vectors for minimum-image wrapping) and candidate/candidate_pilot.py (verify m['signs'] after wet minimization on line 149; re-seed the integrator before c.reinitialize on line 152; replace GLU_CONTROL replica 0 with a mixed-precision run so all 12 replicas share uniform precision). Priority 2 (Parameter Benchmark): Perform 1D/2D dihedral potential energy surface scans on the capped dityrosine motif to benchmark the high-penalty CGenFF torsion terms (penalties 30, 41.1, and 51.1 in candidate/PARAMETER_AUDIT.json lines 90-104) before any mechanical inference. Priority 3 (Controlled Atomistic PMF): In matched triple-helical collagen segments with terminal C-alpha end-restraints (preventing unlinked inter-chain drift) and matched ionic/protonation controls, run umbrella sampling along the inter-chain C-alpha separation reaction coordinate across >= 5 independent solvent/conformer seeds. Priority 4 (Spatial Network Regime Separation): In the coarse-grained fiber network, test whether oxidative crosslink dose alters graph connectivity at all or only modifies edge stiffness on fixed candidate edges; compare degree-preserving spatially constrained rewirings against growing vs fixed-node hub-biased attachment across system sizes L in {32, 64, 128}. Recorded observables: unwrapped/minimum-image C-alpha PMF W(r), dihedral distributions, periodic-wrapping largest component fraction S_1, finite-cluster susceptibility chi, relaxed tangent shear modulus G_T (as a function of solver tolerance and background spring stiffness k_bg), and nonaffine displacement parameter Gamma. Convergence/stop criteria: umbrella histogram overlap > 0.15 between adjacent windows and block-averaged PMF standard error < 0.5 kJ/mol; for network sweeps, bootstrap CI width on percolation/rigidity thresholds < 0.02 in occupancy/edge fraction across >= 30 independent graph seeds per L. Falsifier: If C-alpha PMF curvature or network tangent modulus G_T shows no statistically significant difference from the unlinked/smooth-response null ensemble (Delta AIC < 10 against a smooth polynomial or zerofinite-size scaling collapse across L), reject the hypothesis of a crosslink-induced stiffness ranking or sharp mechanical phase transition.
